messages:
elaine: planning a micro-conf next Wed. 2 tracks (ML infra + product). need reg page copy + zoom setup. can we A/B test CTAs and capture company size? who owns recording split + clips?

sam_ops: I can own infra. question: single meeting with breakouts or two concurrent meetings? leaning two meetings so each track has separate RTMP target. also want OBS fallback.

tyler_events: two meetings is cleaner for schedule. RTMP fallback plan: OBS -> backup RTMP -> ffmpeg -> s3. snippet we used last time: 
```
ffmpeg -i rtmp://zoom/streamkey -c copy -f segment -segment_time 300 s3://redwood-records/%Y%m%d-%03d.mp4
```
also capture SRT sidecar for captions.

maria_content: post-event asset plan: transcript -> auto-split into 3 clips per session: hero (0-90s), deep-dive (90-600s), closing (600s+). deliverables: full recording, three trimmed clips (16:9) + 1:1 social cuts + VTT captions. who owns hubspot tagging?

elaine: i'll own reg page copy + utm mapping. CTA test: "see latency demo" vs "get performance report". add company-size dropdown and a clear consent checkbox for recording reuse. please include speaker consent in the form.

sam_ops: zoom settings checklist: enable cloud recording + record active speaker and gallery; enable live streaming to custom service; use cloud recording as primary and RTMP as backup; disable Zoom auto-caption (we run whisper afterwards). zoom recording settings link: https://zoom.us/account/recording/ (share org defaults).

tyler_events: handoff playbook: raw files -> s3://events/{year}/{month}/{day}/microconf/{track}/ ; accompany with metadata JSON (track, speaker list, start/end, stream_key_used). transcription job triggers Whisper-v2 on our dedicated cluster, then clips + vtt creation. upload outputs to CDN / upload master .mp4 + captions.

maria_content: email flows: immediate thank-you (contains slides + 48h private recording link) -> 24h highlight clip email (hero + CTA to trial) -> 7d segmented nurture based on company_size and watch_pct (watched >=50% => assign to sales SDR). HubSpot props to set: event_name, track, company_size, watch_pct, clip_clicked.

elaine: run-through volunteers pls: Tues 11am. legal: need standard privacy + speaker consent checkbox language. @legal-team can you confirm copy?

zoombot: reminder scheduled: test RTMP keys 30 minutes before event; auto-reminder to speakers 24h and 1h prior.

sam_ops: I'll spin up the OBS fallback machine and post RTMP keys in #eng-infra-ops when ready. will also post the ffmpeg test logs.

tyler_events: let's prepare a 2-minute fallback loop video (branded slide + music) to play if stream dies. also stage a standby producer to switch to backup RTMP quickly.

maria_content: i'll draft the email copy and 3 social snippets and share the asset plan doc in ~1 hour: https://docs.redwood/internals/microconf-asset-plan
